title: 서비스 아이디어 발굴부터 프로토타입까지, AI와 함께 일해본 기록
content: 1편에서는 아이데이션 과정에서 AI Persona를 활용해 여러 사용자의 관점에서 아이디어를 바라보고, 고도화의 힌트를 얻었던 경험을 이야기했습니다. 이번 편에서는 아이디어가 어느 정도 구체화된 이후, UX 리서처로서 Figma Make를 활용해 직접 프로토타입까지 만들어본 경험을 이야기해보려고 합니다. 평소에는 서비스 아이디어와 UX 컨셉을 구체화하는 데 집중했다면, 이번에는 AI를 활용해 그 아이디어를 실제 화면으로 옮기는 과정까지 직접 경험해 봤습니다. 그 과정에서 컨셉 단계와는 또 다른 고민이 필요했고, 동시에 AI 프로토타이핑을 활용해 아이디어를 다시 바라보고 고도화하기도 했습니다. 이번 글에서는 UX 리서처의 관점에서 AI 프로토타이핑을 해보며 무엇을 새롭게 고민했고, 어떤 방식으로 활용할 수 있었는지​를 정리해보려고 합니다. Figma Make가 임의로 채우는 ‘빈칸’ 줄이기 처음에는 아이디어의 배경과 컨셉, 주요 사용 장면 정도만 전달하면 Figma Make가 어느 정도 알아서 화면으로 풀어줄 것이라고…

title: 질문에 맞춰 화면을 만드는 챗GPT, 인텔리전트 UI
content: OpenAI가 챗GPT의 답변을 시각 요소와 조작 가능한 화면으로 구성하는 ‘인텔리전트 UI’를 발표했습니다. 2026년 10월 7일 GPT-6와 함께 공개한 기능입니다. 질문에 따라 글, 그래픽, 버튼, 입력 양식, 차트를 조합해 대화 안에서 사용할 수 있는 인터페이스를 만듭니다. 답변의 형식은 사용자가 하려는 일에 따라 달라집니다.

title: AI를 위한 최고의 UI 라이브러리
content: 누구나 웹이나 앱을 만들 수 있는 시대가 되었습니다. AI에게 아무것도 없는 상태에서 웹이나 앱을 만들어 달라고 요청할 수 있고, 기초적인 기능은 금방 구현할 수 있습니다. 누군가는 Sass 대신 자기에게 맞는 도구를 직접 만들어 쓰기 시작했습니다. 이제 만드는 일의 진입 장벽은 분명 낮아졌습니다. 그렇다면 디자인은 아예 신경 쓰지 않아도 되는 것일까요?

title: Inside New Bahru: The 1960s Singapore high school turned creative business incubator, where design is the priority
content: In Singapore, towering glass skyscrapers are paramount, and the arts aren’t high up on any parents’ dream jobs for their kids. But New Bahru is a space that’s looking to change both of these facts.

title: Holographik designs the identity for Bottone’s furniture show in Zagreb — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Every object that Bottone releases arrives with its own original music, and for Objects & Frequencies, the Berlin-based furniture brand’s first exhibition in Croatia, Zagreb-based design studio Holographik was asked to make those tracks visible. The tracks come from the two brothers who founded the brand, who have been making music together since the 90s. “The object always comes first. Once its form, material and character are defined, we try to understand what that object might become in sound,” Founders Michele…

title: Estudio Cariño invents HOUSE of CALLAGHAN, an Irish stout brand — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Estudio Cariño designed HOUSE of CALLAGHAN, a brand of Irish stout from Cork, for nobody. “This project originated from a rejected proposal for a beer-related client, but we liked it too much to leave it there, so we kept working on it,” Co-founders José Pablo Salazar and Iván Soto Camba tell us. “Once there was no client involved, there was also no brief to follow and nobody asking us to tone anything down.” Between them, the Mexican design duo came up with the name, story, identity and label design.

title: From a studio’s own folders to a product: how Cruzada Supply started — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Gabriel Sutherland and Iliana Zuleta co-founded the Venezuelan design studio Burgo to take on everything around design – carrying an idea from the first conversation through identity, campaigns and physical spaces. They held Burgo to the standards of the industry they wanted to be part of, determined that no client would be blocked by the complexity of international payments. Cruzada Supply turns the systems and shortcuts they collected along the way into resources for other creatives. The Ultimate Folder Setup is…

title: How FAENA Studio based Alterna’s identity on a ‘living journal’ — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Mexico City-based FAENA Studio was commissioned to design the identity for Alterna, a contemporary fine-dining restaurant in the city’s Colonia Condesa neighborhood that brings Italian-rooted cooking together with international influences, Mexican ingredients and the changing seasons.

title: Under After’s Nurture identity blends hand-drawn and generative design — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Nurture builds the infrastructure for epigenomics – the science of the chemical tags and structural changes across a genome that control gene expression without altering the DNA beneath them. Its tools read the epigenome, software interprets it, and systems remodel it. The customers are biology companies, and within them, the scientists who handle epigenomic data. Tellus is the company’s platform. For the brand strategy and identity, Nurture’s founders turned to New York-based creative studio Under After.

title: How Studio Roses made a hotel feel like part of its neighbourhood — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Terreno Barrio Hotel is hospitality group Piñero’s first urban hotel in Palma, Spain. Mallorca-based branding and graphic design studio Studio Roses was brought in early on to develop the hospitality concept itself through the strategy, naming and identity, and on to the tone of voice, brand architecture and signage. The brief asked what could be made from the character of El Terreno, the neighbourhood the site sits in.

title: Classmate Studio reworks the identity for Helsinki restaurant Elm — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: Elm is a restaurant on the edge of Kaivopuisto park in South Helsinki, run by chefs Carlos Henriques, Albert Franch Sunyer and Luka Balac, who are also behind the restaurants Nolla and Nolita. It serves lunch and dinner through the week, with cooking guided by the seasons and inspired by the chefs’ Mediterranean roots. The kitchen works without cling film and cleans with ozonated water and soap made from recycled kitchen oil. Elm occupies the first floor of a villa dating back to 1880, within Puistokatu 4 – a Spac…

title: In Boundary Analytics’ data-driven identity, Cotton Design ensures that the concept is king — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: At Boundary Analytics, a tool that helps businesses understand which marketing efforts are leading to actual sales and growth, data leads all conversations. The analytics platform looks at data – and its patterns and timings – to decode which activities are driving results, and in turn, help companies make better decisions about marketing strategies by showing them what works and when it works. To create an identity that would spotlight this laser focus on working with data, the brand reached out to Cotton Design,…

title: Nihilo’s intentional and layered identity for Ohmek captures the dynamic journey of personal growth — The Brand Identity – Home of the Greatest in Graphic & Brand Design
content: For Ohio-based branding agency Nihilo, led by Co-founders & Creative Directors Emunah Winer and Margaret Kerr-Jarrett, the intersection of branding and storytelling is where their craft truly shines. Their rebranding of Ohmek – a community and retreat centre located in Brooklyn and upstate New York – is a powerful testament to the force of deep collaboration, conceptual design and thoughtful execution.
